الاثنين 31 اوت ꞉2026 آخر أجل لإيداع التر: Monday, August 31, 2026: Deadline for submitting applications
مع اقتراب الموعد النهائي لإيداع الترشيحا: As the deadline for submitting applications to participate in the 19th edition of the "Media Star" competition approaches, Ooredoo Algeria reminds journalists wishing to participate that the final deadline will be Monday, August 31, 2026.
للتذكير، تتناول هذه الطبعة من مسابقة \"ن: As a reminder, this edition of the "Media Star" competition addresses a current and pivotal topic: «The impact of artificial intelligence and 5G technology on social and economic transformations in Algeria».
بإمكان الصحفيين إرسال ملفات ترشحهم مباشر: Journalists can submit their application files directly via the digital platform dedicated to the competition at the following link: http://ore.do/media-star-participation, and they can also participate via email: Mediastar@Ooredoo.dz
المسابقة مفتوحة للأعمال الصحفية المنجزة: The competition is open to journalistic works produced in Arabic, Amazigh, French, and English that were published or broadcast through Algerian media outlets during the period from August 15, 2025, to August 31, 2026.
تتوفر كافة المعلومات المتعلقة بقانون الم: All information regarding the competition rules and how to participate is available on Ooredoo's website, under the «All about Ooredoo» corner, in the "Media Star" sub-section.
للمزيد من المعلومات أو توضيحات، يمكن للم: For more information or clarifications, candidates can contact the Media Relations Department via the following email: Rpubliques@ooredoo.dz
